title: Roken en reklame 1972
descriptions: Opinions on health / details on smoking behaviour / how to stop smoking / buying behaviour / opinions on effect on health of smoking / situation wherein respondent smokes / opinions on smoking / smoking behaviour of relatives / relations / friends / leisure behaviour, hobbies / reading behaviour ( in particular regarding advertisements ) / knowledge of special advertisements for cigarettes, cigars etc. / knowledge of smoking behaviour of vips / image of forms of smoking / situations in which r. could have stopped smoking / neuroticism. Background variables: basic characteristics/ occupation/employment/ income/capital assets/ readership, mass media, and 'cultural' exposure
